other_failure_modes.description: Counting occurrences of a categorical variable (such as user ID) across the combined train and test sets leaks future information into the training data. The model can learn from test set frequencies that would not be available at inference time.

summary: The agent develops a strong LightGBM baseline with good text feature extraction using out-of-fold Ridge predictions. However, the solution suffers from data leakage due to calculating grouped statistics (price z-scores) and user counts on the combined train and test sets. Furthermore, the validation strategy is poorly aligned with the dataset's structure, ignoring both the temporal nature of the data and the presence of repeated users by using random KFold instead of time-based or grouped splits.
